Exchanges.Text:
Good morning, Payments (Demo) team.
Sprint goal: Customers can pay by card and failed payments retry automatically, and there are 6 days left in the sprint.

Daniel, quick check on your earlier commitments: is story 3 done (summary page after idempotency keys), is story 4 done (task 19 after idempotency keys), is task 15 done, and is task 19 itself done—and have you been able to help Maya Lin with bug 12? Then please share what you finished, what’s next, and anything blocking you.
Yesterday I finished card tokenisation and shipped the payment status API version two. Today I'm adding idempotency keys to payment requests. Nothing blocking me.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’re adding idempotency keys to payment requests.

Story 3, Customer payment plan summary page, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Yes, it's on track. I'll pick the summary page back up as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’ll pick up the summary page as soon as the idempotency keys are in.

Task 15, Add structured logging to gateway client, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
Structured logging is nearly done. I'll finish it today.

Daniel, I’ve noted your commitment: you’ll finish it today.

Task 19, Prepare reconciliation report for audit, has been Active for 2 days. Still on track?
The reconciliation report is at risk. I'll start it right after the idempotency keys, and flag it if it slips.

Thanks, Daniel.

Maya, quick check first: is story 5 done from your earlier “I’ll chase them today,” and is bug 12 done from your earlier “I’ll pair with him on the staging access today”? Then please share what you finished, what’s next, and whether anything is blocking you.

Yesterday I reviewed the settlement schema. Today I'm continuing the settlement file validation. I'm blocked on bug 12. The sandbox gateway keeps timing out, and I need access to the platform team's staging gateway.
Sorry to jump in, Maya, but we hit the same gateway timeouts last sprint when we upgraded the TLS library, and it took us days to track down.
Right, I think the root cause was the connection pool settings, so we should compare the gateway configuration between sandbox and staging, and also check whether the sandbox certificate was rotated.
Let's take that offline, I will add it to the parking lot, and Maya, please carry on.
That's everything from me.
Maya, for the access blocker to the platform team’s staging gateway, who can help unblock this?
Daniel can help. He fixed the same gateway timeouts last sprint, so I'll pair with him on the staging access today.

Maya, I’ve noted your commitment: pair with him on the staging access today.

Story 5, Update PCI scan exceptions, has been Active for 4 days. Still on track?
The PCI scan exceptions are waiting on the security review. I'll chase them today.
Maya, I’ve noted the blocker waiting on the security review and your commitment to chase them today, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.

Thanks, Maya.
Admin, is story 1 done and is task 14 done, and then what did you finish, what’s next, and anything blocking you?
Yesterday, I finished the refund API tests.
Today I'm still working on the payment retry story.
No blockers.

Admin, I’ve noted your commitment: Continue working on the payment retry story today.

Task 14, Write retry load test, is past its due date. What is the new date?
It slept because the sandbox was down.
I should finish it tomorrow.
Admin, for the blocker where the sandbox was down and task 14 slipped, who can help unblock this?
Maya can help.
She's already chasing the platform team about the sandbox, so I'll sync with her after the stand-up.
Admin, I’ve noted the blocker that sandbox access is being chased with the platform team and your commitment to sync with Maya after the stand-up, and this blocker will be flagged for follow-up.
Yes, that's right.
That's everything from me.

Blockers raised today were access to the platform team’s staging gateway, waiting on the security review, the sandbox being down, and sandbox access being chased with the platform team. One topic was parked for offline follow-up: the side discussion between Daniel Park and Admin about gateway timeouts and configuration checks. No one was absent, no one failed to respond, and there were no flagged items that nobody covered, so no extra owner follow-ups are needed on that front. Follow-ups, including any needed coordination, are coming in Teams—thank you everyone.
